#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iterator>

using namespace std;

struct Point {
    double x, y;

    Point(double _x, double _y) : x(_x), y(_y) {}

    bool operator==(const Point& other) const {
        return abs(x - other.x) <= GeometryUtils::epsilon && abs(y - other.y) <= GeometryUtils::epsilon;
    }

    double distance(const Point& other) const {
        return GeometryUtils::fastHypot(x - other.x, y - other.y);
    }
};

struct Line {
    double a, b, c;

    Line(const Point& p, double angle) {
        a = sin(angle);
        b = -cos(angle);
        c = -p.x * a - p.y * b;
    }

    Line(double _a, double _b, double _c) {
        double h = GeometryUtils::fastHypot(_a, _b);
        a = _a / h;
        b = _b / h;
        c = _c / h;
    }

    Point intersect(const Line& other) const {
        if (parallel(other))
            return Point(0, 0); // indicates no intersection
        double determinant = b * other.a - a * other.b;
        double x = (c * other.b - b * other.c) / determinant;
        double y = (a * other.c - c * other.a) / determinant;
        return Point(x, y);
    }

    bool parallel(const Line& other) const {
        return abs(a * other.b - b * other.a) <= GeometryUtils::epsilon;
    }

    Line perpendicular(const Point& point) const {
        return Line(-b, a, b * point.x - a * point.y);
    }

    double value(const Point& point) const {
        return a * point.x + b * point.y + c;
    }

    vector<Point> intersect(const class Circle& circle) const;
};

struct Circle {
    Point center;
    double radius;

    Circle(const Point& c, double r) : center(c), radius(r) {}

    vector<Point> intersect(const Circle& other) const {
        double dist = center.distance(other.center);
        if (dist < GeometryUtils::epsilon)
            return {};

        double A = 2 * (other.center.x - center.x);
        double B = 2 * (other.center.y - center.y);
        double C = other.radius * other.radius - radius * radius + center.x * center.x - other.center.x * other.center.x + center.y * center.y - other.center.y * other.center.y;

        Line line(A, B, C);
        vector<Point> points = line.intersect(*this);
        return points;
    }
};

vector<Point> Line::intersect(const Circle& circle) const {
    double dist = distance(circle.center);
    if (dist > circle.radius + GeometryUtils::epsilon) {
        return {};
    }
    Point ip = intersect(perpendicular(circle.center));
    if (abs(dist - circle.radius) < GeometryUtils::epsilon) {
        return {ip};
    }
    double shift = sqrt(circle.radius * circle.radius - dist * dist);
    return {
        Point(ip.x + shift * b, ip.y - shift * a),
        Point(ip.x - shift * b, ip.y + shift * a)
    };
}

namespace GeometryUtils {
    const double epsilon = 1e-8;

    double fastHypot(double x, double y) {
        return sqrt(x * x + y * y);
    }
}

struct DSU {
    vector<int> parent, rank;
    int count;

    DSU(int n) : parent(n), rank(n, 0), count(n) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            parent[i] = i;
    }

    int find(int x) {
        if (parent[x] != x)
            parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
        return parent[x];
    }

    bool unite(int x, int y) {
        x = find(x);
        y = find(y);
        if (x == y)
            return false;
        if (rank[x] < rank[y])
            swap(x, y);
        parent[y] = x;
        if (rank[x] == rank[y])
            ++rank[x];
        --count;
        return true;
    }

    int getCount() const {
        return count;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n; cin >> n;

    vector<int> x(n), y(n), r(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        cin >> x[i] >> y[i] >> r[i];

    vector<Circle> circles;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        circles.emplace_back(Point(x[i], y[i]), r[i]);

    vector<Point> points;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
            vector<Point> intersectPts = circles[i].intersect(circles[j]);
            for (auto& p : intersectPts)
                points.push_back(p);
        }
    }

    vector<bool> bad(points.size(), false);

    for (size_t i = 0; i < points.size(); ++i) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
            if (points[i] == points[j]) {
                bad[i] = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    int nVertices = points.size() - count(bad.begin(), bad.end(), true);
    int nEdges = 0;
    DSU setSystem(points.size());

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int currentCount = 0;
        vector<int> onThis;
        for (size_t j = 0; j < points.size(); ++j) {
            if (!bad[j]) {
                double dist = circles[i].center.distance(points[j]);
                if (abs(dist - r[i]) < GeometryUtils::epsilon) {
                    currentCount++;
                    onThis.push_back(j);
                }
            }
        }
        for (size_t j = 1; j < onThis.size(); ++j) {
            setSystem.unite(onThis[j], onThis[0]);
        }
        nEdges += max(currentCount, 1);
    }

    int nComponents = setSystem.getCount() - static_cast<int>(count(bad.begin(), bad.end(), true));
    cout << 1 + nEdges - nVertices + nComponents << "\n";
    return 0;
}
